summary: Pretty formatting of small negative f32 values overwrote the minus sign with '0' and left the following byte unwritten. The fix writes at the sign-adjusted index, producing the correct decimal string. The fix adds check!(-1.234E-3, -0.001234) to the root-level test_ryu in tests/f2s_test.rs, whose string assertion detects the corrupted output. Both reversal regions occur exactly once in their respective source files. No builds or tests were run.
